description: F5 BIG-IP load balancer data points. Three primary access methods: tmsh CLI (over SSH), iControl REST (HTTPS), and SNMP (F5-BIGIP-LOCAL-MIB / F5-BIGIP-SYSTEM-MIB).

data_points.name: tmsh show sys version
data_points.description: TMOS version, build, edition, hotfix list. The canonical version-discovery call.

data_points.name: tmsh show sys hardware
data_points.description: Chassis serial number, platform type, hardware revision, blade count.

data_points.name: tmsh show sys global-settings
data_points.description: Global system configuration including hostname, mgmt IP, gui-setup state.
data_points.example_query: tmsh show sys global-settings hostname mgmt-dhcp

data_points.name: tmsh list ltm virtual all-properties
data_points.description: Every virtual server (LTM VIP). The cornerstone of LB discovery: address, port, protocol, default pool, profiles, irules.
data_points.example_query: tmsh list ltm virtual all-properties one-line

data_points.name: tmsh list ltm pool all-properties
data_points.description: Server pools that VIPs send traffic to. Includes member nodes, monitors, load-balancing method.
data_points.example_query: tmsh list ltm pool all-properties one-line

data_points.name: tmsh list ltm node
data_points.description: Backend node IP addresses (pool members reference these).

data_points.name: tmsh list ltm rule
data_points.description: iRules — TCL scripts that intercept and manipulate traffic. Critical for understanding business logic.

data_points.name: tmsh list ltm profile http
data_points.description: HTTP profiles (compression, caching, X-Forwarded-For etc.).

data_points.name: tmsh list ltm profile client-ssl
data_points.description: Client-side SSL profiles. Key for cert/key bindings + cipher policy.

data_points.name: tmsh list sys file ssl-cert
data_points.description: Installed SSL certificates with expiry, common name, issuer.

data_points.name: tmsh list net interface
data_points.description: Physical/aggregate interfaces.

data_points.name: tmsh list net vlan
data_points.description: VLANs and their interface assignments.

data_points.name: tmsh list net self
data_points.description: Self IP addresses (the IPs the BIG-IP itself listens on, distinct from VIPs).

data_points.name: tmsh list cm device
data_points.description: Cluster device list — for HA pair discovery.

data_points.name: /mgmt/tm/sys/version
data_points.description: iControl REST: TMOS version. JSON response: {entries: {version: '15.1.5'}}.

data_points.name: /mgmt/tm/ltm/virtual
data_points.description: iControl REST virtual server collection. Returns JSON with all VIPs + their properties.

data_points.name: /mgmt/tm/ltm/pool
data_points.description: iControl REST pool collection.

data_points.name: /mgmt/tm/ltm/node
data_points.description: iControl REST node collection (backend server addresses).

data_points.name: /mgmt/tm/sys/file/ssl-cert
data_points.description: SSL certificates via REST.

data_points.name: F5-BIGIP-SYSTEM-MIB::sysProductVersion
data_points.description: TMOS version via SNMP. OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.3375.2.1.4.2.0.

data_points.name: F5-BIGIP-LOCAL-MIB::ltmVirtualServTable
data_points.description: Virtual server table via SNMP. Walk OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.3375.2.2.10.1.2.

data_points.name: F5-BIGIP-LOCAL-MIB::ltmPoolTable
data_points.description: Pool table via SNMP. Walk OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.3375.2.2.5.1.2.

data_points.name: F5-BIGIP-SYSTEM-MIB::sysCpuSensorTemperature
data_points.description: CPU temperature sensor — health monitoring.
